skills.name: onboarding
skills.description: Scripted onboarding for Conversation Explorer: API key from the user, then sample conversations for their business or a real integration, verified by the first message landing in the dashboard. Use when adding Conversation Explorer, sending conversations or messages to it, integrating its API, or 'onboard me'.
skills.compatibility: Requires a coding agent with file and shell access, network access to https://api.conversationexplorer.com, and a Conversation Explorer account.
